Trample

Birmingham, AL · Downtown · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Trample is a social group ride in Birmingham, AL. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Redemptive Cycles. About 10 miles, easy, all levels. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy, all levels. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Trample group ride

Weekly ride from Birmingham's nonprofit community bike shop. One big group across downtown, about ten mostly flat miles, beginner to expert and all ages. The shop's other events (alley cats, tall bike jousts, Cranksgiving) grow out of this crowd.
